entities.name: Cult of Yore
entities.description: Secret guildless group on Ravnica keeping tomes of the days before the Guildpact.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: Pact creating the guild system, which the Cult believes created false gods.

entities.name: Nephilim
entities.description: Old gods the Cult believes are returning.

entities.name: Great Old One
entities.description: Being granting powers to servants of the Nephilim.

entities.name: Bougrat
entities.description: Druid, only known member of the Cult.

relations.quote: The only member known by name is the druid Bougrat .
